Everything else is design 9's. Expected in the calculator: crossing from 6,000 R near 1.0 h (design 9: 1.41 h); in probes, 8 (F - SL) through a steady-light run within ~+-0.5 at light 0.03-10, ramps > 90% running, falls < 10%, steady light ~25-35%. Watch-points: the copy's error grows with the run response (~40% larger), so onset transients may be larger; the map's +0.3 bias error at light 0.05-0.1 (the far field) is an over-strong copy there.
